jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.title: Determination of Doping and Temperature Dependent Elastic Constants of Degenerately Doped Silicon from MEMS Resonators
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.location: Table I (PDF page 4), Table III (PDF page 8), Eq.8
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.verification: Both complete table pages rendered with Poppler and visually checked; Table III text extraction has corrupt digits and was not used for transcription.
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.method: MEMS resonance plus finite-element inverse extraction; cubic axes C11/C12/C44; 100-oriented Cz device wafers
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.carrier_basis: estimated from resistivity; nominal labels and Table I averages both preserved; not chemical atom concentration
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.uncertainty_note: Published rms error budget; full covariance/confidence coverage unavailable. Independent corner variations are sensitivity scenarios, not a joint confidence interval.
jaakkola_2014_elastic.csv.scope: Elasticity reference only. Not fracture strength, PMF, atomistic potential, or mobility. No Sb data.

noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.title: Electronic strengthening mechanism of covalent Si via excess electron/hole doping
noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.location: Supplement Tables S3/S4 (PDF page 8), S5 (PDF page 9)
noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.verification: Numerical tables read through web PDF text. Direct local supplementary download returned an HTML challenge, rejected as PDF and excluded from provenance hashes.
noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.method: Published static VASP/PAW DFT. HSE06 lattice; LDA elasticity and homogeneous [111] tensile strength; relaxed lateral stress. Excess electrons/holes with uniform compensating background, no impurity atoms.
noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.temperature: static electronic-structure calculation; electronic smearing is not a physical finite-temperature PMF
noda_2023_ideal_strength.csv.scope: Existing published data, not new DFT. Ideal strength is not crack toughness or wafer strength. Do not extrapolate the 1e21-spaced table to ordinary dopant concentrations.

chen_2025_wafer.csv.title: Fracture strength of Czochralski silicon wafers: Statistically rigorous measurement and dopant effects
chen_2025_wafer.csv.location: Tables I and III; Table II with n=30 is NOT the final data used here
chen_2025_wafer.csv.method: Ball-on-ring testing of 17x17 mm slices from 300 mm, 775 um thick, 100-oriented double-side polished Cz wafers; speed 0.2 mm/min; n=50 per condition
chen_2025_wafer.csv.temperature: not assigned numerically in this transcription
chen_2025_wafer.csv.carrier_basis: resistivity-derived carrier concentration; authors approximate as dopant concentration; not an independent atom assay
chen_2025_wafer.csv.scope: Published characteristic strength and SE, not 50 raw observations. Non-significance is not an equivalence proof. Weibull coefficients are evidence only and are not a probability generator.

additional_primary_source.title: Engineering cleavage fracture of silicon via excess charge doping
